as_told.title: Westall school mass sighting and landing

plain: The story is that in 1966, at Westall in Australia, hundreds of schoolchildren and a teacher watched a disc in the sky, in a case UFO investigators call a landing. The UFO documentary maker James Fox tells Michels he went there to investigate it, and that witnesses told him they had been arguing about it for 50 years. In a later episode Fox puts the crowd at more than 300 people watching "this disc zip around in the sky," crediting the account to Shane Ryan and James Rigney. Another guest, Marik von Rennenkampff, gives it as 200 or 300 students, depending on the account, and a teacher, who saw a silver disc banked on its side before it took off at 1,000 miles an hour, though he says nothing of a landing. Karl Nell, a guest on an episode about the Bible and UFOs, mentions it in passing as an almost identical twin of another school sighting. If true, it would be one of the largest group sightings on record.
